discussion_comments.comment_body:
good catch. This is a modified version I submitted as PR to the strands repo too that allows to install strands without PyAudio (which is not required when you run in agentcore). Will change to the official strands sdk for now
https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/pull/1361

The uv.lock file clearly shows the precise versions of all direct and transitive dependencies used at a given commit, providing a snapshot of the project's dependency tree. Committing this file allows us to lock dependency versions, the risk of introducing new bugs due to unexpected dependency updates is significantly reduced.
